subject.title: [Feature]: Editable file panel in Control UI (sessions.files.set with hash CAS + CodeMirror editor)

question: Should OpenClaw approve general admin-authorized edits to existing session workspace files, including an explicit overwrite-after-conflict action?
rationale: Current main intentionally stops at bounded session reads and fixed-name agent writes; source inspection cannot decide whether arbitrary existing workspace files and force-overwrite belong inside the remote admin trust boundary.

options.title: Approve CAS plus overwrite
options.body: Add existing-file-only admin writes with race-safe CAS, structured conflicts, and a clearly labeled overwrite retry using the server's current hash.

options.title: Approve CAS without overwrite
options.body: Reject stale saves and require reload and manual reapplication, avoiding force-overwrite in Control UI.

options.title: Keep session files read-only
options.body: Limit writes to the existing allowlisted Agents Files API and consider landing only tool-card navigation.

recommendation.title: Approve CAS plus overwrite
recommendation.body: Add existing-file-only admin writes with race-safe CAS, structured conflicts, and a clearly labeled overwrite retry using the server's current hash.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsored and landed the adjacent viewer surface and opened this explicit mutation-contract follow-up.
